features.title: Safety
features.text: Your child’s safety is our top priority. Our experienced and qualified team provides care to the highest standard. Regular training and ongoing attention help us create a safe, caring environment every day.

features.title: Healthy Meals
features.text: We focus on healthy meals prepared from high-quality ingredients that support children’s development. We make sure every meal is nutritious, tasty and suited to the needs of growing children.

features.title: Thoughtful Equipment
features.text: Our nursery is comprehensively equipped by the renowned Haba Pro brand, known for modern ecological design, durable workmanship and a wide range of high-quality educational resources.

features.title: Learning Through Play
features.text: Our activities combine learning and play, giving children joyful and developmental experiences. Creative sensory activities support motor, cognitive and social development in a friendly atmosphere.

about.title: Welcome to our nursery
about.text: Welcome to our nursery — a place filled with joy, care and safe development. Our mission is to support every child on their unique journey, caring for their individual needs as well as their early social, emotional and cognitive development. Our team consists of qualified professionals who are passionate about working with young children. Through regular training and certification, we provide a high standard of care and safety so that parents can feel confident their child is in good hands. We create a warm and supportive atmosphere where children discover the world through play, creative activities and everyday challenges.
about.quote: Welcome to Smerfiki — together we create a place where your child can feel at home!

recruitment.title: Looking for a place for your child?
recruitment.text: Choose a location and get in touch. We will answer questions about availability, settling-in, the daily routine and our new location.
